support: Reproduce legacy full-bin 1 m midpoint slowness quadrature; additionally compare model slowness integrated on exactly the accepted observed support segments, at no more than 1 m midpoint spacing
empiricalBaselines: separate linear depth curves for shale and sandstone
separate quadratic depth curves for shale and sandstone

metrics: Equal-parent bias, MAE, root mean parent MSE; depth, facies and quadrant breakdowns; retain every baseline outcome
